label: Act's simple priority over potency: route use, first-being version and a composition route
summary: Target: STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY (a4d3261a) on the critical spine to STMT-GOD-EXISTS. (1) Map: its four verified derivations share no leaf; under strict expansion (least fixpoint, leaves only underived statements) the minimal cuts are the fifteen sets {substance-to-simple bridge 9226c6af} x {one motion-fork leaf: 6b9fedc2, 6ca87431, 010988b9, 079b53bf, excluded middle} x {one ground-route leaf: 8a1d7012, bf374f2e, a4606a6b}. 3b2d2d46 (IndependentPriority) is the same Lean body over the freely supplied InPotency (POTENCY_2); a4d3261a links adopted POTENCY_1 on a type with a free parameter, so they are one proposition under two sense labels, not a sense passage. (2) Route use: the consumers the root routes cannot bypass (ComponentFirstness.noComponentFirst, the only derivation of 09c6d5f0, and FirstBeingNoPotency) apply act priority only at a supposed first being. (3) Weak version FirstBeingActPriority, registered as strictly weaker than 3b2d2d46 (Control.ColdStone), equivalent given non-overlap to STMT-FIRST-BEING-IS-IN-NO-WAY-IN-POTENCY (Control.Facts); noComponentFirstOfWeak rederives 09c6d5f0 from it. (4) Price of the strong reading: with non-overlap and STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND it gives every being in potency in any respect a distinct actual concrete ground of its being in act in that respect (Control.Facts item 4): formally an actually hot ground for a stone in potency to heat, virtually a ground having what its grounded beings lack. (5) Positive tree weakOfComposition: every first being is in act in some respect, act with potency makes composite (restricted so prime matter does not falsify it), every composite has a distinct cause of its being (q.3 a.7 reading), efficient cause prior (q.2 a.3 reading); each needed (Control.CompositionOmissions). (6) Graph at STMT-GOD-EXISTS, ten root arguments: removing a4d3261a and 3b2d2d46 left 2/10 before, 9/10 after (classical-root projection 92ab7c94 lost: 8f956c81 consumes 3b2d2d46 directly); with both removed, removing any one of the first three tree premises returns 2/10. Senses: PRIOR_1 throughout; temporal and substance senses only through existing explicit coverage and bridge; receptive potency differs in Lean type; 86f10ec3's potency link corrected from POTENCY_1 to POTENCY_2 to match its free parameter. Failed or rejected approaches: (a) deriving the weak version from Aquinas's reduction reason: vacuous at a first being, whose potencies are idle (ActPriorFromMotionFacts item 5); (b) unrestricted 'whatever is in potency is composite': prime matter, in act in nothing, would falsify it if counted among the beings, so it was restricted to beings in act in some respect, adding the premise that a first being is in act in some respect; (c) first spec with the weak version linked to POTENCY_1 and premise a4d3261a: rejected by truth check as unbridged mixing with the POTENCY_2 non-overlap record, resolved by linking the weak version to POTENCY_2 and deriving it from 3b2d2d46; (d) registering the converse (first-being-no-potency gives the weak version) as an argument: kept as a control fact instead, since that conclusion has no consumers and only derives from act priority. Objections (substantive objection standard): strongest standing rival is an existentially first being with actualized accidental states (dipolar theism, a necessary initial cosmic state; unread leads from memory), targeting tree premise 2 or 3 by the distinction between dependence for being and for an accidental actuality; price: an uncaused composite first being or a simple being in act and potency; not an established counterexample. Never-actualized potencies: substantive against the strong reading's scope on the grounding routes only. Quantum indeterminism: targets the reduction reading as universal; its mechanism is interpretation-dependent and the tree does not use reduction. No independent warrant recorded for tree premises 1 and 2. Nothing is established; all new premises are open.
blocker: Open: every premise of the composition tree; whether a first being can be an uncaused composite (premise 3 at a first being) against a read dipolar or initial-state account; warrant for 'every first being is in act in some respect' and for act-with-potency composition. The eight consumers of 3b2d2d46 still take the strong reading (truth check warns without strong_version_needed); rewiring them, starting with 8f956c81, would restore the classical-root route when act priority is removed. Literature named here is unread.
